label: Heritage State
description: Classic-car states and touches — period hardware only, nothing a coachbuilt legend could not actually do.

items.name: bonnet-propped
items.text: bonnet propped open on its rod over a spotless carburetted engine bay, braided lines and polished cam covers on display

items.name: wire-wheels-locked
items.text: front wire wheels turned onto full lock, knock-off spinners catching the light

items.name: top-folded
items.text: convertible top folded away under a fitted leather tonneau boot

items.name: driving-lamps-lit
items.text: auxiliary driving lamps lit, warm tungsten glow pooling ahead of the chrome bumper

items.name: engine-ticking
items.text: engine off and ticking as it cools, the faint smell of hot oil and warm chrome almost visible in the shot

items.name: rally-plates
items.text: period rally plates and scrutineering stickers on the nose, a route book resting on the dash

items.name: morning-dew
items.text: overnight dew misted evenly across the brightwork, one clean wipe across the windscreen

items.name: picnic-touring
items.text: a wicker picnic hamper strapped to the boot rack, tartan rug folded over the door top

items.name: just-waxed
items.text: freshly hand-waxed, swirl-free reflections rolling unbroken across the coachwork
